tasks.title: Finish final save and downloaded-file browser acceptance

acceptance: Record load/layout-shift metrics, interaction latency, data sizes, tool versions and measurement method.
Distinguish lab observations from field Core Web Vitals; do not treat Accessibility/SEO scores as performance results.
Document measured bottlenecks and explicit acceptance budgets; fix and remeasure any resulting scoped regressions.

Install and reopen the web app; check cached shell/offline status, private-data boundaries and reconnect without replay.
Check draft recovery after reload and a real app/browser interruption; record device/OS/browser and exact results.

completion_rules: A task passes only with its stated reproducible acceptance evidence on the named source/artifact/environment.
Unavailable, deferred or held is never a pass. A consciously accepted limitation/exclusion needs an explicit recorded decision.
Report fixture, configured, live and installed-artifact evidence separately; do not sum overlapping test totals.
Complete original inventory/local implementation does not imply every vendor account, device or release is live verified.
Public publication is a user-held distribution choice; do not publish to close a checklist.
Optional proposals do not block the original plan and do not become approved work without a request.
